import { createAnimationTask, addAnimationTask, type AnimationManager } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function startHover(manager: AnimationManager, node: { position: { y: number } }): (strength: number) => void {
    const restY = node.position.y;
    let strength = 1;
    let elapsed = 0; // in seconds

    const task = createAnimationTask((mgr, deltaMs) => {
        elapsed += deltaMs / 1000;
        const phase = elapsed % 1; // 0 to 1 second cycle
        let factor: number;
        if (phase < 0.5) {
            factor = phase / 0.5; // 0 to 1
        } else {
            factor = 1 - (phase - 0.5) / 0.5; // 1 to 0
        }
        node.position.y = restY + strength * 0.5 * factor;
    });

    addAnimationTask(manager, task);

    return (s: number) => {
        strength = s;
    };
}
```

export function startHover(manager: AnimationManager, node: { position: { y: number } }): (strength: number) => void {

    addAnimationTask(manager, task);

    return (s: number) => {
        strength = s;
    };
}
```
